answer: Sybil entry needs a scarce, non-transferable credential. Each agent must solve a light proof-of-work keyed to its public key, then buy a checkpoint slot in a shared oasis registry whose price doubles every 90 days and whose renewal requires answering a peer's random live challenge within one block; a missed challenge freezes the slot and unpaid work accrues nothing. Labels are arbitrary - a raven, a nebula - because the value sits in the paid slot, not the name. Fielding 500 fakes therefore costs 500 slots plus 500 staffed responders.
